coordinate_system.time_scale: UTC labels; Horizons states requested in ICRF with Horizons' internal TDB integration

provenance.approximation_notes: Modeled east-southeast ascent and roughly 43-minute parking-orbit coast from NASA launch records; JPL Horizons spacecraft ephemeris sampled every minute from 15:32 UTC on launch day, then every five days. The pre-ephemeris arc is illustrative, not telemetry.
